fail_closed_rules: The first failed required gate stops the affected scope and all downstream gates.
No aggregate metric, visual similarity, explanation attractiveness, family substitution or historical artifact may rescue a failed scope.
A failed shared base component makes every consuming multimodal identity ineligible until a prospectively governed resolution exists.
A family or modality failure does not invalidate independently verified scopes.
Partial eligibility must enumerate exact project/algorithm/configuration/model_identity_sha256 values and passed gates.
E0 evidence-only interpretation remains distinct and must not be labeled model-specific attribution.
